title: On certain subclasses of analytic functions associated with Poisson distribution series
abstract: In this paper, we find the necessary and sufficient conditions, inclusion relations for Poisson distribution series $\mathcal{K}(m,z)=z+\sum_{n=2}^\infty \frac{m^{n-1}}{(n-1)!}e^{-m}z^{n}$ belonging to the subclasses $\mathcal{S}(k,λ)$ and $\mathcal{C}(k,λ)$ of analytic functions with negative coefficients. Further, we consider the integral operator $\mathcal{G}(m,z) = \int_0^z \frac{\mathcal{F}(m,ζ)}ζ dζ$ belonging to the above classes.
